mapper.select: select ts.id, ts.match_id, ts.team_id, t.team_name, ts.opponent_team_id, ot.team_name as opponent_team_name, ts.points, ts.rebounds, ts.offensive_rebounds, ts.defensive_rebounds, ts.assists, ts.steals, ts.blocks, ts.turnovers, ts.fouls, ts.field_goals_made, ts.field_goals_attempted, ts.field_goal_pct, ts.three_points_made, ts.three_points_attempted, ts.three_point_pct, ts.free_throws_made, ts.free_throws_attempted, ts.free_throw_pct, ts.possessions, ts.efficiency, ts.data_status, ts.confirmed_by, ts.confirmed_time from basket_match_team_stat ts left join basket_team t on ts.team_id = t.id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team ot on ts.opponent_team_id = ot.id and ot.is_delete = 0 where ts.match_id = #{matchId} and ts.is_delete = 0
mapper.update: update basket_match_team_stat set is_delete = 1, update_time = now() where match_id = #{matchId} and is_delete = 0

update basket_match_team_stat set data_status = #{toStatus}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_time = #{confirmedTime}, update_time = now() where match_id = #{matchId} and is_delete = 0 and data_status in #{s}
mapper.insert:
insert into basket_match_team_stat (match_id, season_id, stage_id, team_id, opponent_team_id, points, rebounds, offensive_rebounds, defensive_rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers, fouls, field_goals_made, field_goals_attempted, field_goal_pct, three_points_made, three_points_attempted, three_point_pct, free_throws_made, free_throws_attempted, free_throw_pct, possessions, efficiency, data_status, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values
(#{item.matchId}, #{item.seasonId}, #{item.stageId}, #{item.teamId}, #{item.opponentTeamId}, #{item.points}, #{item.rebounds}, #{item.offensiveRebounds}, #{item.defensiveRebounds}, #{item.assists}, #{item.steals}, #{item.blocks}, #{item.turnovers}, #{item.fouls}, #{item.fieldGoalsMade}, #{item.fieldGoalsAttempted}, #{item.fieldGoalPct}, #{item.threePointsMade}, #{item.threePointsAttempted}, #{item.threePointPct}, #{item.freeThrowsMade}, #{item.freeThrowsAttempted}, #{item.freeThrowPct}, #{item.possessions}, #{item.efficiency}, #{item.dataStatus}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.isDelete})
